asset.description: Declared `ASSET` axis, inherited from the diary.

caption.description: One factual sentence describing the image; the shelf's payload and `Fact.content`.

concerns.description: Review flags; the vision enum is `identifiable_people`, `vehicle_plate`, `third_party_branding`, `unsafe_practice_visible`, `poor_legibility`, `not_construction`.

fact_class.description: Provenance class: this fact is a model's reading of an image, not a value the source reported.

financial_period.description: Declared `FINANCIAL_PERIOD` axis; derived from `occurred_at` when not inherited.

legal_entity.description: Declared `LEGAL_ENTITY` axis, inherited from the diary.

observation_id.description: Stable identity of the per-photo observation: `{parent diary source id}:{photo ordinal}`. Maps to `Fact.source_id`/`external_id`.

occurred_at.description: Time of the parent diary event, inherited unchanged; the observation has no independent event time.

parent_diary_source_id.description: Source id of the `site_diary` fact this photo belongs to; the join back to the diary and the prefix of `observation_id`.

photo_index.description: Zero-based ordinal of the photo within the diary, assigned in `_photo_urls` order; the other half of the identity.

project.description: Declared `PROJECT` axis, inherited from the diary.

source_image.description: Dimensions and container format of the fetched image, from the encoder.

source_system.description: Originating system of the parent record; `ASSIGNAR` today. Stamped from the diary, not chosen by the vision pass.

work_type.description: The civil work visible, or the literal `none_visible`.
